text: FABLE REVIEW SCHEDULED (risk 1 of 6). Why risky: this exact hole survived TWO review passes, and survived the second one BECAUSE the reviewer wrote a justification for it ('carries no relation beyond Raw's'). A third reviewer disproved it by probe. Forgeability of a status carrier is the single recurring defect of this whole plan. Review must attack: can a consumer in storymodel4s.consumer assert Known/Unmapped/NotApplicable? Does the probe use typeCheckErrors with a positive control, or a bare negative typeChecks that returns false on ANY error?
